meta.scope: Correct S357 secondary EVOKE review falsely tagged as cross-subject validation

records.title: Closing the loop on chronic pain with ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs open-loop spinal cord stimulation: systematic and longitudinal pooled analysis of the EVOKE study

decisions.notes: The publisher PDF is a secondary synthesis of repeated follow-up reports from one EVOKE randomized trial program (134 randomized participants), not a new participant-level model or cross-subject validation. Its RR/RD 0.18 label and 36-month open-loop responder rate conflict with the source trial report; use only as bounded review context, not an independent effect estimate. The publisher PDF was accessed through a browser-agent route while ordinary requests met Cloudflare 403.
